caption: The drawing is composed of several architectural and decorative elements rendered in black ink on a light beige background. On the right side, there is a tall, vertically oriented structure resembling a column or a section of furniture, with detailed line work indicating wood grain, relieved sections, and measurements marked in feet and inches. To the left and above this, there are various detailed sections and profiles, including ornamental corner motifs with floral and scrollwork patterns, a circular medallion with a symmetrical organic design, a turned spindle or baluster, and a pair of rings or decorative knobs shown in perspective. Along the lower left, two large segmented profiles are displayed, each defined primarily by a series of curved and angled lines representing molded surfaces. The drawing is enclosed within a single-line rectangular border, and the name "Ernest Towers Jr." appears in the lower right corner outside the border. The entire composition is rendered with precise, unshaded lines, and the objects are spaced evenly within the border.
title: Clock
